show.description: man separated from his family due to a tragic accident, finds himself working as a sweeper in the same company that he built years ago - only to be humiliated by his own son who has no idea who he is. While dealing with all the humiliation, he saves his own son from a major business conspiracy and reclaims his family as well as his position.
